message: "checks.panel.ok--button" is on a <span> with no ARIA role.
fix: Render a native button or add role='button' (and its state attributes); for read-only content use --text.

message: "checks.panel.twice--text" is also used by src/a.tsx:12, and both can render together.
fix: Give each element its own name, or scope them (`modal_a.save--button`, `modal_b.save--button`).

message: "checks.shared.label--text" is also used by src/b.tsx:6.
fix: Give each element its own name, or scope them (`modal_a.save--button`, `modal_b.save--button`).

message: "checks.panel.save--button" is on a <div> with no ARIA role.
fix: Render a native button or add role='button' (and its state attributes); for read-only content use --text.

message: "checks.panel.plain" has no role suffix but is a button.
fix: Add --button.

message: "checks_control" has no scope.
fix: Prefix it with where it lives, e.g. "area.checks_control--button". Suggested: "<scope>.checks_control--button".

message: <div> with testid "checks.panel.clickable" handles input but has no ARIA role.
fix: Render a native control (button, a[href], input) or add role= with its state attributes.

message: "checks.panel.item_{key}--text" has runtime data outside the key.
fix: Only the last word may carry runtime data, after ":" (`name:${value}`). Suggested: "checks.panel.item:{key}".

message: "checks.panel.item_undefined--text" can render the text "undefined" (via src/b.tsx:7).
fix: Make sure the value is always set, or render no testid when it is missing.

message: testid is made entirely of runtime data (via src/b.tsx:8).
fix: Write the scope and name as literals; runtime data may only fill the key: `scope.name:${value}`.

message: "LegacyName" has the word "LegacyName", which is not lower_snake_case.
fix: Words match [a-z][a-z0-9_]*, e.g. "legacy_name". Suggested: "<scope>.legacy_name".

message: "checks.panel.ok--button" is used in exclusive branches with different roles (button at src/a.tsx:5, null at src/a.tsx:10).
fix: Use the same element kind in both branches, or give them different names.

message: "checks.pair.item--text" is also used by src/a.tsx:84, and both can render together.
fix: Give each element its own name, or scope them (`modal_a.save--button`, `modal_b.save--button`).

message: "checks.panel.go--button" is used in exclusive branches with different roles (button at src/a.tsx:9, link at src/a.tsx:9).
fix: Use the same element kind in both branches, or give them different names.

message: "checks.panel.go--button" is on a link (<a>).
fix: Use --link, or render an element with role button.

message: "checks.cap.cell:r01_c01--text" can take more than 256 values; the rest are left out (src/cap.tsx:13).
fix: Key the testid by one value (`:${id}`) instead of a product of lists, or split it into separate testids.

message: key of "checks.markup.mention:{key}--link" is an open string (name: string).
fix: Key from a fixed set (literal union / as const), an entity field (channel.name), or type it.

message: Plugin slot "gone" (checks.plugins.removed:{key}--button) is in the published contract, but the webapp no longer renders it.
fix: Render the slot's testid again, or remove it from the contract (a breaking change for plugin test packages).

message: key of "checks.plugins.by_name:{key}--button" is an open string (p.name: string).
fix: Key from a fixed set (literal union / as const), an entity field (channel.name), or type it.

message: Plugin slot "unkeyed" (checks.plugins.by_name:{key}--button) must be keyed by pluginTestKey(pluginId), but its key is a string (string).
fix: Render the key with pluginTestKey() from @mattermost/shared/utils/test_id.

message: "checks.plugins.extra:{key}--button" is keyed by plugin but isn't in the published plugin slot contract.
fix: Add it to PLUGIN_SLOT_TEST_IDS in @mattermost/shared/utils/test_id.
